description.narrative: America Embalagens S.A. (America, or the Company) is one of the leading Brazilian manufacturers of plastic closures and rigid plastic packaging, serving the food & beverages, personal care, household and beauty markets. Headquartered in the state of Rio Grande do Sul (South Brazil), the Company operates four plants, three in Brazil and one in Argentina. America is undergoing an expansion project to increase its capacity in Brazil.

IFC expects the Project will contribute to generate environmental effects driven by the adoption of advanced technology facilitating a substantial increase in the utilization of recycled plastic. The project is also expected to generate economy-wide effects through the creation of value added and employment opportunities. Beyond the Project, IFC expects that the investment will have a powerful market demonstration effect and incentivize other market participants to adopt innovative technologies that enable a substantial reduction in plastic usage within the personal care product packaging sector.
